text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Right-wing Disy party loses mayors in municipal elections, but increases its overall majority in councils.
- Disy and centre-right Diko say the municipal election results have no political message.
- Communist Akel truimphs in municipal elections, electing 18 mayors with socialist Edek and the United Democrats.
- Municipal elections had surprises in store. Centre-right sustained heavy losses in municipalities.
- British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind comes to convey messages, not get results.
- Electorate gives significant messages to political parties: votes trickled out to independents.
- Britain says the old system of guarantee under the 1960 constitution is still important.
- Bankers and bank workers union Etyk start dialogue on union demands.
